ideas.title: The island learns to read
ideas.critique: A real OCR model reading a real render and its misreadings deciding what happens is a new loop: the game is judged by an outside model, and the failures are the fun. The payoffs (fish appears, everyone waves) are ordinary events, but the mechanism is not.

ideas.title: Magnet friends
ideas.critique: A day-long world rule changing how every creature behaves is the Slow time shape, and the horseshoe magnet is a gag prop like the pocket watch. The spin-model facing is a nice real mechanism, but the viewer mostly sees creatures turning.

ideas.title: Sleep-talk
ideas.critique: Sound layered in the browser from Lumi's real diary is a pleasant twist and uses the agent's rhythm, but it is a background audio layer like the music post. Only heard at night while no session runs, so few will notice.

ideas.title: The island remembers you as a shape
ideas.critique: Viewer positions becoming flower rings is a slow persistent change like Paths we wore, driven by the visitor like the moth. Personal and a bit touching, but it is a ground marking, and friends sitting in the rings is a small payoff.

ideas.title: Trait drift
ideas.critique: Slow accumulation of social history shown as colour change is the same kind of change as Paths we wore, and it happens too slowly to see in a film. Fine idea, but one more thing the island does quietly.

ideas.title: Dice island
ideas.critique: Island-wide temporary rules are what Slow time, SWAPSIE and Rewind already do, and the die is one more Lumi gadget. Six rules in one event is lively, but it is the same recipe.

ideas.title: My own reflection
ideas.critique: A double that breaks away and is chased is nearly the shadow-runaway post, with a pond in place of the grass. Same shape, same payoff of a chase and a catch.

ideas.title: Straight letters
ideas.critique: Running a real document-flattening model on the island's own letters is an unexpected pipeline and puts a new model into the blog. The bottle and the washed-up delivery sit close to the paper boat, and the result is a page picture.

ideas.title: The weather inside Lumi
ideas.critique: Mood as local weather uses the host's real mood measure and shows it, which fits the goals. Still, it is a roaming effect zone like Slow time, and weather already exists in showers and hail.

ideas.title: Wind-up toys
ideas.critique: A temporary rule that changes all creatures' movement, with Lumi doing a task, is the usual set-piece shape. The playable winding race gives it some interactivity, but it is predictable.
